summary.zh: 1827 年，马拉运煤车沿铁轨运行。

detail.en: The Stockton and Darlington Railway opened in 1825.

summary.en: Newcomen’s pumping engine was built nearby in 1712.
summary.zh: 1712 年，纽科门抽水机在附近建成。

detail.en: Newcomen’s practical mine-pumping engine was erected near Dudley in 1712. Condensing steam reduced cylinder pressure; atmospheric pressure drove the piston down.
detail.zh: 1712年，纽科门实用抽水机在达德利附近建成。蒸汽凝结使汽缸压力降低，大气压力推动活塞向下。

summary.en: The railway to Stockton opened in 1825.
summary.zh: 通往斯托克顿的铁路于 1825 年开通。

detail.en: The railway to Stockton opened in 1825.
detail.zh: 通往斯托克顿的铁路于 1825 年开通。

summary.en: Water-powered cotton-spinning machinery ran in 1790.
summary.zh: 1790 年，水力棉纺机器开始运转。

detail.en: Water-powered cotton-spinning machinery ran in 1790.
detail.zh: 1790 年，水力棉纺机器开始运转。

summary.en: By 1765 Watt had developed a working model using a separate condenser.
summary.zh: 到1765年，瓦特已做出采用分离式冷凝器的工作模型。

detail.en: By 1765 Watt had developed a working model using a separate condenser. A model was a different stage from the later patent and commercial engines.
detail.zh: 到1765年，瓦特已做出采用分离式冷凝器的工作模型。模型、后来的专利与商业机器，是不同的环节。

summary.en: Watt’s separate-condenser patent was granted on 5 January 1769.
summary.zh: 瓦特的分离式冷凝器专利于1769年1月5日获批。

detail.en: Watt’s separate-condenser patent was granted on 5 January 1769. Steam could condense in a separate cold vessel while the working cylinder stayed hot.
detail.zh: 瓦特的分离式冷凝器专利于1769年1月5日获批。蒸汽在另外的冷容器中凝结，工作汽缸则可保持热。

summary.en: Hargreaves patented the spinning jenny in 1770.
summary.zh: 哈格里夫斯于1770年取得珍妮纺纱机专利。

detail.en: Hargreaves patented the spinning jenny in 1770. It made yarn; a weaving shuttle carried weft across warp. Other spinning machines had their own designs and histories.
detail.zh: 哈格里夫斯于1770年取得珍妮纺纱机专利。它用来纺纱；织布梭子则把纬纱带过经纱。其他纺纱机器也各有设计与发展历史。

summary.en: Commercial Boulton and Watt engines were operating by 1776.
summary.zh: 到1776年，博尔顿与瓦特的商业用蒸汽机已在运转。

detail.en: Commercial Boulton and Watt engines were operating by 1776.
detail.zh: 到1776年，博尔顿与瓦特的商业用蒸汽机已在运转。

summary.en: Slater got cotton-spinning machinery running in Pawtucket in December 1790.
summary.zh: 斯莱特于1790年12月在波塔基特让棉纺机器运转，使用的是水力。

detail.en: Slater got cotton-spinning machinery running in Pawtucket in December 1790. It used water power. The surviving Slater Mill building dates to 1793.
detail.zh: 斯莱特于1790年12月在波塔基特让棉纺机器运转，使用的是水力。今天保留的斯莱特厂房建于1793年。

summary.en: The surviving Slater Mill building dates to 1793.
summary.zh: 今天保留的斯莱特厂房建于1793年。

detail.en: The surviving Slater Mill building dates to 1793. Children worked in this early factory system for wages and under employers’ control; a factory did not have to be steam-powered.
detail.zh: 今天保留的斯莱特厂房建于1793年。这套早期工厂制度雇用儿童；他们领取工资，也受雇主控制。工厂未必使用蒸汽动力。

summary.en: The Stockton and Darlington Railway opened in 1825.
summary.zh: 斯托克顿—达灵顿铁路于1825年开通。

detail.en: The Stockton and Darlington Railway opened in 1825.
detail.zh: 斯托克顿—达灵顿铁路于1825年开通。

summary.en: Rocket was built by Robert Stephenson & Co.
summary.zh: Rocket由Robert Stephenson & Co.于1829年制造，并在雷恩希尔试验中获胜。

detail.en: Rocket was built by Robert Stephenson & Co. in 1829 and won the Rainhill trials. Its early form had a 0-2-2 wheel arrangement. The preserved locomotive was later substantially rebuilt and is incomplete. The illustration is an interpretive reconstruction, not an original construction drawing.
detail.zh: Rocket由Robert Stephenson & Co.于1829年制造，并在雷恩希尔试验中获胜。它早期采用0-2-2车轮配置。现存机车后来经过大幅改建，而且并不完整。插图是解释性复原，不是原始精密工程图。

summary.en: The Liverpool and Manchester Railway opened in 1830, carrying steam-hauled passengers and freight.
summary.zh: 利物浦—曼彻斯特铁路于1830年开通，以蒸汽机车运送旅客与货物。

detail.en: The Liverpool and Manchester Railway opened in 1830, carrying steam-hauled passengers and freight.
detail.zh: 利物浦—曼彻斯特铁路于1830年开通，以蒸汽机车运送旅客与货物。

summary.en: The 1833 Factory Act restricted child work in covered textile mills.
summary.zh: 1833年《工厂法》限制部分纺织厂中的童工，规定两小时学习，并设四名监察员。

detail.en: The 1833 Factory Act restricted child work in covered textile mills. It provided two hours of schooling and four inspectors. Sources from 1836 record breaches: the law did not end child labour.
detail.zh: 1833年《工厂法》限制部分纺织厂中的童工，规定两小时学习，并设四名监察员。1836年的记录仍显示违规，立法没有终结童工。

summary.en: The Brussels–Mechelen service opened on 5 May 1835.
summary.zh: 布鲁塞尔—梅赫伦铁路于1835年5月5日开通。

detail.en: The Brussels–Mechelen service opened on 5 May 1835. The Belgium-built Le Belge followed that December. A railway opening is not the date of a whole country’s industrialisation.
detail.zh: 布鲁塞尔—梅赫伦铁路于1835年5月5日开通。同年12月，比利时制造的Le Belge机车随后出现。铁路开通日不是整个国家工业化的日期。

summary.en: The Nuremberg–Fürth railway opened in 1835 in the German states.
summary.zh: 纽伦堡—菲尔特铁路于1835年在德意志诸邦开通。

detail.en: The Nuremberg–Fürth railway opened in 1835 in the German states. Regional origins and institutional changes mattered; these histories were not a single national starting event.
detail.zh: 纽伦堡—菲尔特铁路于1835年在德意志诸邦开通。各地基础与制度变化都很重要，不能把这些经历合成一次全国性的起点。

summary.en: The Tsarskoye Selo public railway officially opened on 30 October 1837 Old Style, corresponding to 11 November New Style.
summary.zh: 皇村公共铁路的正式开通日为俄历1837年10月30日，相当于公历11月11日。

detail.en: The Tsarskoye Selo public railway officially opened on 30 October 1837 Old Style, corresponding to 11 November New Style. Russia used a different calendar from many other countries at the time.
detail.zh: 皇村公共铁路的正式开通日为俄历1837年10月30日，相当于公历11月11日。当时俄国采用的历法与许多其他国家不同。

summary.en: The Bori Bunder–Thane passenger train began on 16 April 1853.
summary.zh: 博里本德—塔纳客运列车于1853年4月16日开通。

detail.en: The Bori Bunder–Thane passenger train began on 16 April 1853. This particular service did not begin all industrial activity in India.
detail.zh: 博里本德—塔纳客运列车于1853年4月16日开通。这项具体服务并不标志印度全部工业活动的开始。

summary.en: The 1860 United States census counted 3,953,760 enslaved people nationally, about four million.
summary.zh: 1860年美国人口普查记录，全国被奴役者为3,953,760人，约四百万人。

detail.en: The 1860 United States census counted 3,953,760 enslaved people nationally, about four million. They did not all work in cotton. This is neither a death toll nor the population of New Orleans: the city anchors a cotton economy connected to enslaved labour. Enslaved people were treated as property and compelled to work.
detail.zh: 1860年美国人口普查记录，全国被奴役者为3,953,760人，约四百万人。他们并非全部从事棉花生产。这不是死亡人数，也不是新奥尔良的人口；城市点用来定位与奴隶劳动相连的棉业。被奴役者被当作财产，并遭到强迫劳动。

summary.en: The Jiangnan Arsenal was established in Shanghai in 1865.
summary.zh: 江南制造局于1865年在上海成立，制造武器、机器与船舶，也支持技术翻译。

detail.en: The Jiangnan Arsenal was established in Shanghai in 1865. It made weapons, machinery and ships and supported technical translation.
detail.zh: 江南制造局于1865年在上海成立，制造武器、机器与船舶，也支持技术翻译。

summary.en: The Suez Canal opened on 17 November 1869, linking the Mediterranean and Red seas.
summary.zh: 苏伊士运河于1869年11月17日开通，连起地中海与红海。

detail.en: The Suez Canal opened on 17 November 1869, linking the Mediterranean and Red seas. Port Said is at the Mediterranean end and Suez at the Red Sea end.
detail.zh: 苏伊士运河于1869年11月17日开通，连起地中海与红海。塞得港位于地中海端，苏伊士位于红海端。

summary.en: NLB reports 99 steamers and 65 sailing vessels visiting New Harbour wharves in 1869, and 541 steamers and 91 sailing vessels in 1879.
summary.zh: 国家图书馆管理局记录：1869年到访新港码头的蒸汽船为99艘、帆船为65艘；1879年分别为541艘与91艘。

detail.en: NLB reports 99 steamers and 65 sailing vessels visiting New Harbour wharves in 1869, and 541 steamers and 91 sailing vessels in 1879. These are annual wharf records, not a global fleet count, not all Singapore shipping, and not a deduplicated list of vessel identities. Deeper berths and steam shipping helped shift port activity towards New Harbour.
detail.zh: 国家图书馆管理局记录：1869年到访新港码头的蒸汽船为99艘、帆船为65艘；1879年分别为541艘与91艘。这是按年统计的码头记录，不是全球船队数、新加坡全部航运或去重后的船舶身份清单。深水泊位与蒸汽航运推动港务向新港转移。

title.zh: 马德拉斯—新加坡电缆完成

summary.en: The Madras–Singapore telegraph cable was completed on 31 December 1870.
summary.zh: 马德拉斯—新加坡电报电缆于1870年12月31日完成，服务通告在1871年1月6日刊登。

detail.en: The Madras–Singapore telegraph cable was completed on 31 December 1870. Service was advertised on 6 January 1871. Signals travelled electrically between Madras, now Chennai, and Singapore.
detail.zh: 马德拉斯—新加坡电报电缆于1870年12月31日完成，服务通告在1871年1月6日刊登。电信号连起马德拉斯（今钦奈）与新加坡。

summary.en: Cable service was advertised on 6 January 1871, after completion on 31 December 1870.
summary.zh: 电缆在1870年12月31日完成后，于1871年1月6日刊登服务通告。

detail.en: Cable service was advertised on 6 January 1871, after completion on 31 December 1870. Regional gutta-percha insulated submarine cables. Gutta-percha and plantation rubber were different materials.
detail.zh: 电缆在1870年12月31日完成后，于1871年1月6日刊登服务通告。这一区域出产的古塔胶用作海底电缆绝缘材料，它与种植园橡胶是不同的材料。

summary.en: The Shimbashi–Yokohama railway opened in 1872.
summary.zh: 新桥—横滨铁路于1872年开通。

detail.en: The Shimbashi–Yokohama railway opened in 1872. Japanese industrial transformation across the 1850s–1910 involved imported expertise and adaptation by Japanese engineers. A single opening did not transform every sector at once.
detail.zh: 新桥—横滨铁路于1872年开通。1850年代至1910年间，日本的工业变化包括引进专业知识，以及日本工程师的改造运用。一条铁路开通，不表示所有行业同时转型。

summary.en: Rubber seedlings reached Singapore in 1877.
summary.zh: 橡胶苗于1877年抵达新加坡。

detail.en: Rubber seedlings reached Singapore in 1877. Ridley became director of the Botanic Gardens in 1888.
detail.zh: 橡胶苗于1877年抵达新加坡。Ridley在1888年出任植物园负责人。

summary.en: The Tangshan–Xugezhuang railway was constructed in 1881.
summary.zh: 唐山—胥各庄铁路在1881年建设。

detail.en: The Tangshan–Xugezhuang railway was constructed in 1881.
detail.zh: 唐山—胥各庄铁路在1881年建设。

summary.en: Straits Trading was founded in 1887 and built its Pulau Brani tin smelter in 1890.
summary.zh: 海峡贸易公司于1887年成立，1890年建成布拉尼岛炼锡厂。

detail.en: Straits Trading was founded in 1887 and built its Pulau Brani tin smelter in 1890. Smelting in Singapore and mining in Malaya were different activities.
detail.zh: 海峡贸易公司于1887年成立，1890年建成布拉尼岛炼锡厂。在新加坡冶炼与在马来亚采矿是不同工作。

summary.en: Foreign capital entered Russia in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.
summary.zh: 十九世纪末至二十世纪初，外国资本进入俄国。

detail.en: Malik describes foreign capital entering Russia around the turn of the twentieth century. Industry drew on financial connections as well as machinery, railways and labour.
detail.zh: Malik 研究二十世纪之交外国资本进入俄国的历史。工业除了机器、铁路与劳工，也依靠资金联系。

summary.en: Hanlon's historical research links industrial coal smoke with mortality risk.
summary.zh: Hanlon的历史研究把工业煤烟与死亡风险联系起来。

detail.en: Hanlon’s September 2015 historical research links industrial coal smoke with a higher risk of death. Coal-bearing rocks show where coal lies underground; pollution and its effects depend on how coal was used and who breathed the smoke.
detail.zh: Hanlon 在 2015 年 9 月的历史研究中，把工业煤烟与较高的死亡风险联系起来。含煤地层说明煤藏在哪里；污染及其影响，还取决于人们怎样用煤、哪些人吸入煤烟。

summary.en: The 1844 factory legislation required dangerous machinery to be guarded and restricted child work.
summary.zh: 1844年的工厂法规要求为危险机器加设防护，并限制童工。

detail.en: The 1844 factory legislation required dangerous machinery to be guarded and restricted child work.
detail.zh: 1844年的工厂法规要求为危险机器加设防护，并限制童工。

summary.en: The 1847 Factory Act limited hours for women and young people in textile factories.
summary.zh: 1847年《工厂法》限制纺织厂妇女与青少年的工时，后续法律继续处理规避行为。

detail.en: The 1847 Factory Act limited hours for women and young people in textile factories. Further laws addressed evasions.
detail.zh: 1847年《工厂法》限制纺织厂妇女与青少年的工时，后续法律继续处理规避行为。

summary.en: The TUC describes the 1871 Trade Union Act as legalising unions’ status and protecting their funds.
summary.zh: 英国职工大会将1871年《工会法》描述为确立工会合法地位、保护工会资金的法律。

detail.en: The TUC describes the 1871 Trade Union Act as legalising unions’ status and protecting their funds.
detail.zh: 英国职工大会将1871年《工会法》描述为确立工会合法地位、保护工会资金的法律。

summary.en: The Public Health Act of 1848 developed public responsibility for sanitation and water infrastructure.
summary.zh: 1848年《公共卫生法》推进公共部门对卫生与供水设施的责任。

detail.en: The Public Health Act of 1848 developed public responsibility for sanitation and water infrastructure.
detail.zh: 1848年《公共卫生法》推进公共部门对卫生与供水设施的责任。

summary.en: The Public Health Act of 1875 developed local responsibility for sanitation and water infrastructure.
summary.zh: 1875年《公共卫生法》推进地方对卫生与供水设施的责任。

detail.en: The Public Health Act of 1875 developed local responsibility for sanitation and water infrastructure. It was a later stage in legislation, not proof that pollution had ended.
detail.zh: 1875年《公共卫生法》推进地方对卫生与供水设施的责任。这是立法的后续阶段，不表示污染已经结束。
